description: NFR-06 least-privilege controls. status is 'enforced' only when a file in this repo (named in applied_in) applies the control to a real resource; otherwise 'documented-only' (a written policy that the Lab cannot attach, because every principal runs as LabRole or LabInstanceProfile).

placeholders.ArtifactBucket: S3 bucket owned by the persistent driftgate-storage stack: driftgate-artifacts-<account id>-<region>, exported as driftgate-storage-BucketName (models, reference logits, bundles, build logs, run records)
placeholders.RulePrefix: Name prefix of the pipeline's EventBridge rules: the orchestrator stack name (CloudFormation names each rule <stack>-<LogicalId>-<suffix>)
placeholders.TargetGroup: Serving target group, owned by the network stack (deploy/cloudformation/network.yaml, default driftgate-serving)
placeholders.Repository: CodeCommit repository name (orchestrator/template.yaml RepositoryName, default driftgate)
placeholders.MetricNamespace: CloudWatch namespace of the gate metric (T-13)

controls.lab_reality: Runs as LabRole. Policy lists the calls orchestrator/handler.py makes: S3 run records and lock, SSM SendCommand to the build host, SNS publish, CodeDeploy CreateDeployment

Runs as LabRole. Runs Orchestrator.decide in-process: approve starts the deployment; reject or timeout ends the run and starts the queued build, so it needs the same S3, SSM and CodeDeploy calls (no SNS)
Uses LabInstanceProfile. Git fetch in /opt/driftgate goes through the CodeCommit credential helper with the instance profile credentials (codecommit:GitPull)
One AWS::Lambda::Permission per EventBridge rule (push, build status, deploy state, approval sweep), each with that rule's exact SourceArn; stricter than the prefix form in the policy file
InvokeFunctionUrl requires FunctionUrlAuthType NONE and InvokeFunction is restricted to calls via the URL. The one-time token authorizes the request

Random single-use token, stored only as a SHA-256 hash; rejected after the 1,800 s approval timeout (orchestrator/config.json approval.timeout_seconds) and swept every 5 minutes; GET only renders a confirm page, POST decides (PRD 6.8, FR-27)
driftgate-storage stack: account-only, TLS-only, encrypted puts only; also versioning, SSE-S3 and Block Public Access (NFR-05)
Ingress TCP 80 only; HTTP 80 listener because the Lab has no domain or certificate
Ingress only from the ALB security group on the serving port; the network stack's target group is the only route in. Holds with UseNat=false (public subnets) too
No inbound rules (with or without NAT)
No port 22 in any security group, no key pair in launch templates; shell via Session Manager
Launch templates set HttpTokens required, hop limit 1
